motivation.r231: R231 found 61.87% of V25 error energy in layers 12-15 and positive error correlation in all 100 rows; R251 therefore targets a global deep-layer closure bias rather than per-network tuning.
motivation.no_leader_invention: R230 found competitor methods undisclosed; no leader method is assumed.

excluded: R247 V25-NM24-YOUNG-D21-RIGHT-SPARSIFY and all 2:4 D21 sparsity rescue
all families marked closed/rejected in research/history.json
history_dedup.novelty_claim: No history entry or required evidence describes replacing V25's scalar regenerated-K4 off-diagonal coefficient with a per-row standardized diagonal-K4 ratio while simultaneously deleting the V25 scalar adaptation.

math: Keep the frozen V25/V22 table value lambda_l entering transported diagonal K4: t_g=(W*W)@g_prev; t_v=var-(W*W)@var_prev; dG=t_g+t_v*lambda_l.
Delete V25's scalar rr=mean(dG0)/mean(var), rr/ref clip, fnp.power adaptation, and second dG recomputation.
Define q_i = dG_i / max(var_i, 1e-10) using fnp.maximum and fnp.divide.
Replace wk431_ij = C_off_ij * lambda_l by wk431_ij = C_off_ij * q_i. No column symmetrization is added because wk431 is the ordered (3,1) slice.
All other V25 equations, ranks, transports, term program, final trim, and outputs remain unchanged.
candidate.rationale: The scalar lambda assumes homogeneous fourth-cumulant/covariance coupling across neurons. A row-local standardized diagonal-K4 ratio uses already transported K4 and variance to represent heteroscedastic coupling without adding a new low-rank transport or target-derived coefficient.

rules: All new output-affecting numerical operations are fnp primitives: maximum, divide, reshape, multiply, matmul/add/subtract inherited from parent.
No new nontrivial Python-scalar arithmetic is allowed in the candidate path; constants 1e-10 and table coefficients are literals passed as operands to fnp array operations.
Any unresolved scalar arithmetic introduced by implementation is terminal UNKNOWN/NO-GO before execution.

fixtures.construction: one Gaussian latent coordinate; zero bias; first weight has only input row 0 nonzero; later weights dense deterministic hash-uniform; exact post-ReLU mean is the two-ray analytic expectation.
fixtures.exact_truth: For each layer, propagate positive- and negative-ray slopes a_plus,a_minus exactly in float64 and set truth=(a_plus+a_minus)*0.3989422804014327.

cost_bound.argument: Candidate removes two fnp.mean reductions, scalar ratio/clip/power adaptation, and the second t_v*lambda plus add used to recompute dG. It adds one fnp.maximum(var,1e-10) and one fnp.divide(dG,var_safe); the wk431 elementwise multiply remains one n-by-n multiply with broadcast row operand instead of scalar operand. Therefore the frozen static operation-count bound is <= parent, subject to verification in the exact pinned FlopScope runtime before any public panel.
cost_bound.gate: No public run unless exact source-level accounting under pinned FlopScope confirms candidate <= 806303721965 mean FLOPs and no unresolved unmetered arithmetic.
